title: Somaliland Form Four Examination 2023 - English Paper One
subject: English

questions.section: Part One: Reading Comprehension 1 – Reading One: The importance of water (20 Marks) – Answer these Questions
questions.question:
Read the passage “The importance of water.”:

It can be argued that the only thing we need more than water is oxygen. There will be no life on earth without water, hence the need to take special care of what we have of it. How many times do we need to drink water in a day? Can we cook without water? How about when we need to take a bath, or do laundry? All living things, plants, animals and humans need water, but is there enough water to last forever Allah Challenges us in Sureh Almulk. "If your water dries out one morning, who is there that can bring your clear flowing water?"

There is so much water in the world but most of it is not potable water. Much of the water in the oceans is not good for many things outside of providing a suitable home for marine life, We do not have good alternatives for fresh water, so we need so take care of the little we have, Most people do not know that there is a serious water Crisis going on and predictions for the future are even gloomier. It is so bad that some people are sighting that future wars will be fought over water.

If water is not abused, we will never run the risk of running out of it. Modern man has the bad habit of abusing everything Allah has blessed him with. Allah has warned us about wasting and likened waters to the brothers of the devil? We waste liters of much needed water every time we flush the toilet, if all flush toilets are replaced with water efficient ones like those found in airplanes, the world will save so much.

It does not look likely that people, will willingly go back to the old fashioned traditional toilets, even though doctors are advising that it is more effective for relieving our bowels, should it be imposed in places like Somaliland?

For years now, the rains has been disappointing and the impact of this had on our Communities is alarming. Rivers and lakes are drying up around the world and the water that comes into Hargeisa on trucks is depleting too.

In advanced Countries such as the US, states like California have been going through painful droughts for years on end, which are having negative effects on the people and the economy. Researchers are warning countries with sufficient water to be Careful lest it becomes the new Crude oil those with meagre water supplies have to be cautious with water usage and it starts with you. Let's spread the world. If each person tells the others, there'll be one less ignorant person around.

---

1. Why do living things need water? (2 Marks)
questions.answer_guide: Because there is no life without water – plants, animals and humans need it to survive (drinking, growing, cooking, cleaning). It is the most needed thing after oxygen.

2. List three ways of saving water? (6 Marks)
   a. ..........
   b. ..........
   c. ..........
questions.answer_guide: Any three: replace flush toilets with water-efficient ones; do not waste water (turn off taps, fix leaks); use only the water you need for bathing, cooking and laundry; reuse water; harvest rainwater; spread awareness so others also save water.

questions.section: Part 4 Writing (20 Marks)
questions.question:
Choose one of the following themes to develop a neat piece of writing. (200 --- 250 words).

1. Child Rights
   In your writing, state:
   i. Caring Children
   ii. To give prober education
   iii. To give children health care
   iv. Role of children in country development.

2. Importance of Livestock rearing
   i. Economically
   ii. Role of rural development
   iii. Culturally
   iv. Family income
questions.answer_guide:
Choose ONE theme and write 200–250 words:
• Introduction – introduce the topic.
• Body – one paragraph per guide point (i–iv) with explanation and examples.
   Topic 1: children's right to love and protection, proper education, health care (vaccination, nutrition), and how educated, healthy children build the nation.
   Topic 2: livestock as Somaliland's main export and source of foreign exchange; jobs and markets in rural areas; cultural value (dowry, diya, prestige, hospitality); milk, meat and sales as family income.
• Conclusion – summarise and give a recommendation.
Marks are usually given for content, organisation, vocabulary, grammar and spelling.
